result.summary: This pull request introduces concurrent block processing for the initial synchronization of BaseIndex subclasses, specifically targeting blockfilterindex and txindex. It adds a general-purpose ThreadPool utility and a new configuration flag `-indexworkers=<n>` to divide block ingestion across background worker threads while maintaining sequential writes where required.
result.problem: Initial construction of optional indexes (such as compact block filters and txindex) runs strictly sequentially, taking hours to complete on large chain histories even when multi-core hardware and fast storage are available.

open_concerns: l0rinc raised an Approach NACK over diff complexity and observed that txindex showed minor performance regressions on SSD setups rather than speedups
Conflicting benchmark results across different hardware and virtualized environments regarding txindex parallel scaling
Handling of potential disk head thrashing on spinning HDDs under concurrent reads
resolved_concerns: Deadlock and shutdown lifecycle issues in the ThreadPool class were identified and addressed with fuzz testing and RAII cleanup
Decoupling the ThreadPool into a prerequisite PR (#33689) was agreed upon to simplify review

categories.rationale: Initial index builds take hours, and multiple reviewers confirmed multi-fold speedups (from 6x to 16x on SSDs) for blockfilterindex. It provides durable value for index synchronization and lays groundwork for batched database writes in follow-up work.

categories.rationale: The thread pool is a clean general utility designed for asynchronous task submission, but as an internal utility supporting other subsystems it is reasonably deferrable on its own.

result.card: This pull request parallelizes initial index synchronization for blockfilterindex and txindex using a worker thread pool configured via -indexworkers. Benchmark testing by multiple contributors demonstrates substantial speedups for block filter indexing (up to 6x faster on SSDs), though reviewers observed mixed results and occasional slowdowns on txindex. An Approach NACK was lodged regarding review complexity and txindex scaling, leading the author to mark the PR as draft while extracting the ThreadPool component into #33689. The PR is currently stale, with merge conflicts requiring a rebase before code review can proceed.
